mapper.sql: (g.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} OR (#{enterpriseId} = 1 AND g.enterprise_id IS NULL)) AND g.session_type = 'hs_as' AND COALESCE(g.state, 'ACTIVE') IN ('ACTIVE', 'GROUP_DISSOLVED')

CAST(g.session_id AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST(#{enterpriseId} AS VARCHAR) AS "enterpriseId", g.session_name AS "name", COALESCE(g.state, 'ACTIVE') AS "status", CAST(g.creator_id AS VARCHAR) AS "creatorId", CAST(g.project_id AS VARCHAR) AS "projectId", g.create_time AS "createdAt", g.update_time AS "updatedAt", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM byai.byai_session_member m WHERE m.session_id = g.session_id AND (m.com_acct_id = #{enterpriseId} OR (#{enterpriseId} = 1 AND m.com_acct_id IS NULL)) AND m.mem_obj_type = 'USER') AS "memberCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM byai.byai_session_member m WHERE m.session_id = g.session_id AND (m.com_acct_id = #{enterpriseId} OR (#{enterpriseId} = 1 AND m.com_acct_id IS NULL)) AND m.mem_obj_type = 'AGENT') AS "agentCount"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM byai.byai_session g WHERE AND POSITION(LOWER(#{keyword}) IN LOWER(COALESCE(g.session_name, ''))) > 0 AND (#{status} = '' OR COALESCE(g.state, 'ACTIVE') = #{status}) ORDER BY g.create_time DESC NULLS LAST, g.session_id DESC

SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM byai.byai_session child WHERE child.parent_session_id = g.session_id AND (child.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} OR (#{enterpriseId} = 1 AND child.enterprise_id IS NULL)) AND child.session_type = 'h_as') AS "conversationCount" FROM byai.byai_session g WHERE AND g.session_id = #{id}

SELECT CAST(m.byai_session_member_id AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST(m.mem_obj_id AS VARCHAR) AS "objectId", m.mem_obj_type AS "type", m.mem_name AS "name", m.user_role AS "role" FROM byai.byai_session_member m JOIN byai.byai_session g ON g.session_id = m.session_id WHERE AND g.session_id = #{id} AND (m.com_acct_id = #{enterpriseId} OR (#{enterpriseId} = 1 AND m.com_acct_id IS NULL)) AND m.mem_obj_type IN ('USER', 'AGENT') ORDER BY m.byai_session_member_id DESC

SELECT CAST(child.session_id AS VARCHAR) AS "id", child.session_name AS "name", COALESCE(child.state, 'ACTIVE') AS "status", CAST(child.creator_id AS VARCHAR) AS "creatorId", CAST(child.project_id AS VARCHAR) AS "projectId", child.create_time AS "createdAt", child.update_time AS "updatedAt" FROM byai.byai_session child JOIN byai.byai_session g ON g.session_id = child.parent_session_id WHERE AND g.session_id = #{id} AND child.session_type = 'h_as' AND (child.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} OR (#{enterpriseId} = 1 AND child.enterprise_id IS NULL)) ORDER BY child.create_time DESC NULLS LAST, child.session_id DESC
